EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services - Lost Pitchfork ID Card
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
Your student ID card has been reported as lost or stolen. We have disabled the ASU portion of your card to prevent any unauthorized dining purchases or building access. If you have not contacted Midfirst Bank please do so by calling 888-643-3477.
If you find your card or when you get a replacement please email us at sundevilcardinfo@asu.edu and we will re-enable the ASU portion of your ID card.
To get a replacement Pitchfork card please visit a Midfirst Bank Campus Banking Center. https://asu.midfirst.com/inside/campus-banking-centers/
Regards,
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
